interpretations.question: Exact wording of the always-present note text (ADR-028 clause 3 fixes the required content, not the verbatim string).
interpretations.chosen: Restart-only: 'A Jellyfin server restart is required for a change to this setting to take effect.' Mixed: the same sentence plus ' Some paths apply the change immediately.'
interpretations.basis: ADR-028 clause 3 requires note text stating that a server restart is required for the change to take effect, and for a mixed setting additionally that some paths apply the change immediately; the phase task instructs pinning the exact strings in a test. The mixed form keeps the restart-only sentence as an exact prefix so both categories provably carry the statement clause 3 requires.
interpretations.impact: User-visible wording only; the strings are pinned by RestartRequiredNoteTextTests. No persisted state, limit/window/unit meaning, or save/validation semantics change.

interpretations.question: Placement and identity of the static note markup.
interpretations.chosen: A <div class="fieldDescription restartRequiredNote" id="<elementId>RestartNote"> placed inside the same .inputContainer as the input, after the input (and its range description where present).
interpretations.basis: The task says to prefer static markup adjacent to each affected input and to keep it consistent with the existing fieldDescription usage; the id scheme gives an explicit test-checkable association with SettingClassification.PageElementIds.
interpretations.impact: Presentation/DOM structure only; no behavior or data semantics.

test_sensitivity: TheStaticPageCarriesExactlyTheRestartRequiredNotes fails when a restart-required note is removed (probe A: deleted the maxImageDimensionPixels note -> all 3 cases failed), when a note is duplicated (probe C: duplicated the renderCacheTtlMinutes note -> 2 cases failed: id-set equality and the pinned count), and when the note id no longer matches the classification-derived element id (regex set equality).

EveryRestartRequiredSettingCarriesItsExactNoteNextToItsElement fails on a missing note (probe A -> 3/3 cases failed), a changed or mislabelled note text (probe B: relabelled the restart-only renderCacheTtlMinutes note with the mixed text -> 2 cases failed), a detached note (asserts note index is after its input and before the next input container), and a note after the script (asserts note index < script start).

MixedNotesStateImmediateApplicationAndRestartOnlyNotesDoNot fails when a mixed setting loses the immediate-application clause or a restart-only setting gains it (probe B failed it), i.e. when a mixed setting is mislabelled restart-only or a restart-only setting is mislabelled mixed.
No new guard/validator is introduced by this task; the task 16.2 SettingClassification constructor guard remains covered by RestartRequiredSettingsTests.TheClassificationRejectsAnInconsistentEntry.
